newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Merrill ups Brooklyn Union.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Merrill ups Brooklyn Union.

text.p: -- Merrill Lynch said it raised Brooklyn Union Gas Co to near-term accumulate from neutral and maintained its long-term buy rating.
-- Merrill analyst Donato Eassey said he expects Brooklyn Union's earnings to "snowball" to $3.40 per share in the year 2000, up from $2.15 in the current fiscal year ending next September.
-- The analyst said Brooklyn Union's results will be driven by growth in its unregulated businesses, in which it is now free to conduct 50 percent of its business.
-- "These guys have shown a propensity to make money on the non-regulated side," Eassey said. Unregulated businesses now account for about 15 percent of company revenues.
-- Eassey said he set earnings estimates of $2.32 per share for fiscal 1998, $2.75 for fiscal 1999 and $3.40 for fiscal 2000.
-- He said his price objective on the stock is $34 over the next 12 months.
